newsitem.title: USA: GranCare says non-competition suit meritless.
newsitem.headline: GranCare says non-competition suit meritless.

text.p: GranCare Inc said Wednesday it believes that the lawsuit filed against it by Manor Care Inc and Vitalink Pharmacy Services Inc is without merit.

Earlier, Manor Care and Vitalink said they had filed a joint lawsuit against GranCare to enforce a non-competition agreement between the companies and block a proposed merger between GranCare and Living Centers of America Inc.
The suit states that under the pact entered into four months ago, GranCare is prohibited from becoming involved directly or indirectly in the institutional pharmacy business for three years.
Manor Care is the majority shareholder in Vitalink.

GranCare said in its response that it has not breached the non-competition agreement and that the consummation of its merger with Living Centers of America Inc will not breach the non-competition agreement.
The company said it has engaged outside counsel, and intends to vigorously defend itself and assert various counterclaims against Manor Care and Vitalink.
